Developer Roles
Trading under Publicis Communications
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane
Front End Developer (also known as Front End Engineer, Web Developer, Front End Software Developer, Software Developer, CSS Developer, HTML Developer, Programmer, Software Engineer)
The purpose of the Front End Developer is to be a hands-on developer working in a cross discipline team to deliver the front-end portion of websites & web applications. Collaborating with other engineers (front-end & back-end), creatives, and clients, the front-end developer may implement web experiences via working in front-end workflows within a project team of technical & non-technical members to help drive business outcomes for our clients.
Working closely with UX designers to translate wireframes, this role also requires maintenance & management of frontend libraries alongside the building, testing & deployment of code.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Worked in software engineering roles focussed on front-end development for 4+ years.
?	Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
?	Proficiency in reactive front-end experiences using ReactJS and/or VueJS.
?	Experience building canvas applications.
?	Working knowledge of application performance parameters as well as the ability to assess and optimize them.
?	Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Salary: $85K – 105K package

Senior Front End Developer
We are on the hunt for a Senior Front End Developer to be a hands-on developer working with cross discipline teams to deliver the front-end portion of websites & web applications. Leading a team of engineers (front-end & back-end) while working closely with other creative teams and clients, the Senior Front-End Developer is responsible for building & maintaining various features as per clients’ requirements. This may include the implementation of web experiences via working in front-end workflows within a project team of technical & non-technical members to help drive business outcomes for our clients.
Working closely with UX designers to translate wireframes, this role also requires maintenance & management of frontend libraries alongside the building, testing & deployment of code.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Worked in software engineering roles focussed on front-end development for 6+ years.
?	Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
?	Proficiency in reactive front-end experiences using ReactJS and/or VueJS.
?	Experience building canvas applications.
?	Working knowledge of application performance parameters as well as the ability to assess and optimize them.
?	Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Salary – Over threshold


Back End Developer (also known as Web Developer, Software Engineer, Programmer, Software Developer, Back-End Software engineer)
The Back End Developer is an analytical, goal-oriented person who will work with team members to troubleshoot and improve existing back-end applications and processes. Using their understanding of programming languages and tools, the Back End Developer will analyze current codes and industry developments, formulate more efficient processes & solve problems, to create a more seamless experience for users. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication, computer, and project management skills.
The role will involve: compiling and analysing data, processes, and codes to troubleshoot problems and identify areas for improvement, collaborating with the front-end developers and other team members to establish objectives and enable the design to be more functional, implementing cohesive codes where necessary to enhance the user experience. The back end developer will also be responsible for developing ideas for new programs, features or products via research & monitoring of industry trends.
To succeed as a backend developer, you should be focused on building a better, more efficient program and creating a better end-user experience. You should be knowledgeable, collaborative, and motivated. The ideal candidate will have relevant tertiary qualification in computer programming, computer science or a related field; or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification, but also ideally have a minimum of 2 years experience in a similar role. Fluency or understanding of specific languages, such as Java, PHP, or Python, and operating systems may be required. The candidate will also have a strong understanding of the web development cycle and programming techniques and tools; be focused on efficiency, user experience, and process improvement and also have excellent project and time management skills.
Salary – Over threshold

•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.

Multiple Positions – Engineering

Offshore Staff Assist 
All States and Territory’s in Australia
Local and FIFO positions available 
Engineering (Trades & Professionals)
Full time
$70,000 – $150,000 per annum

Vacancy Listing Dates 09/07/2026 to 10/08/2026

Explore a world of career opportunities with us across every state of Australia, including New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania, the Australian Capital Territory, and the Northern Territory. Join our dynamic team today and start your journey in the state that feels like home.

Offshore Staff Assist is currently hiring for a broad range of positions across various sectors on behalf of our client. We recognize your enthusiasm for becoming a part of our team and are keen to support your professional development. Our focus on excellence and innovation is at the core of our business, offering a solid foundation for your skills to develop and succeed. 
We are not just offering jobs, but long-term career opportunities that promise growth and advancement within the company we service. If you're looking for a role where your contributions are valued and your professional growth is a priority, please join us to build a future where your career aspirations align with our commitment to progress and hard work.
We're currently looking for qualified: 
•	Engineer Professional / Manager 
•	Civil Engineer 
•	Civil Engineering Draftsperson
•	Civil Engineering Technician 
•	Contract Administrator 
•	Electrical Engineer 
•	Electrical Engineering Technician 
•	Electrical Engineering Draftsperson 
•	Mechanical Engineer 
•	Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson 
•	Mechanical Engineering Technician 
•	Mechatronics Engineer 
•	Mining Engineer 
•	Industrial Engineer
•	Structural Engineer


To be considered for the below roles, you must have a minimum 3 years’ experience.

Engineer Professional / Manager
We are seeking a highly skilled Engineer Professional / Manager to oversee engineering projects across various disciplines. This leadership role involves managing project teams, coordinating design and development tasks, and ensuring projects meet technical specifications and regulatory standards. Candidates should possess a strong engineering background, proven management skills, and experience in project oversight.
Civil Engineer
Join our team as a Civil Engineer, responsible for designing, planning, and overseeing construction and maintenance of building structures and infrastructure. Candidates should be proficient in analyzing survey reports, maps, and other data to plan projects, as well as in technology applications like CAD software.
Civil Engineering Draftsperson
We are looking for a Civil Engineering Draftsperson skilled in creating detailed technical drawings and plans for civil engineering projects using CAD software. Responsibilities include preparing visual guidelines for construction teams, assisting in design processes, and providing input on structural specifications.
Civil Engineering Technician
Seeking a Civil Engineering Technician to assist in planning, designing, and managing construction projects. This role involves supporting engineers by preparing estimates, conducting land surveys, and testing building materials. Practical experience with CAD software and strong analytical skills are essential.
Contract Administrator
We require a Contract Administrator to manage contracts for engineering projects. Candidates should be adept at reviewing and drafting legal documents, ensuring compliance with terms and conditions, and liaising between parties involved in project execution. Strong negotiation and organizational skills are critical.
Electrical Engineer
Join our dynamic team as an Electrical Engineer, designing, developing, and testing electrical devices and systems. Responsibilities include overseeing the manufacturing of these devices, solving related problems, and ensuring compliance with standards. Knowledge of electrical simulation software is preferred.
Electrical Engineering Technician
We are hiring an Electrical Engineering Technician to support the development and maintenance of electrical systems and equipment. This role involves conducting tests, compiling data, and assisting engineers in creating prototypes and new applications. Proficiency in diagnostic tools and technical software is required.
Electrical Engineering Draftsperson
Seeking an Electrical Engineering Draftsperson to prepare detailed drawings and schematics for electrical systems using CAD software. The ideal candidate will assist in planning layouts and the preliminary construction specs, working closely with engineers to ensure accuracy and compliance with codes.
Mechanical Engineer
We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to design, analyze, and manufacture new mechanical devices. Responsibilities include creating blueprints, conducting computational simulations, and testing prototypes to improve system performance.
Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson
Join our team as a Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson, responsible for creating technical drawings and plans for mechanical devices and systems using advanced drafting software. A keen attention to detail and strong knowledge of engineering principles are required.
Mechanical Engineering Technician
We require a Mechanical Engineering Technician to assist in the design, development, and testing of mechanical equipment. Duties include preparing reports, performing diagnostics, and supporting the engineering team in technical aspects of project delivery.
Mechatronics Engineer
Seeking a Mechatronics Engineer to work on the integration of mechanical, electrical, and computer engineering into cohesive systems. Candidates should have expertise in robotics, control systems, and smart technologies, and be able to innovate and improve product functionalities.
Mining Engineer
We are looking for a Mining Engineer to plan, design, operate, and close mines safely and sustainably. Responsibilities include conducting preliminary surveys, designing underground and surface mines, and overseeing operations to ensure environmental and safety standards are met.
Industrial Engineer
We are wanting an Industrial Engineer with grain milling equipment experience and PLCs. A strong commitment to a safe working environment. result.description:
## ICT Support Technician
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Support Technician to join our team and provide reliable support across our computer infrastructure, software systems, and web technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, maintaining hardware and software environments, and ensuring end users receive timely and effective assistance. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong communication skills and a genuine passion for technology. This position suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to delivering high-quality technical support.
## Key Responsibilities
- Assess software and hardware requirements to identify appropriate technical solutions and resolve user-reported problems effectively.
- Respond promptly to enquiries from staff regarding software and hardware issues, providing clear guidance and practical resolutions in a professional manner.
- Install, configure, and maintain approved software applications, ensuring systems remain up to date, secure, and aligned with organisational standards.
- Adapt and modify existing programs and system configurations to better meet the evolving needs of end users and business operations.
- Implement, configure, and monitor computer networks, supporting both wired and wireless infrastructure to maintain consistent connectivity across the organisation.
- Design, update, and maintain organisational websites, ensuring content accuracy, functionality, and a positive user experience.
- Repair and replace peripheral equipment such as printers, terminals, monitors, and modems, maintaining accurate records of assets and service activity.
- Provide first- and second-level technical support to end users, either in person, remotely, or via a helpdesk or call centre environment, logging all incidents and resolutions through the appropriate ticketing system.
- Promote the efficient and effective use of applications and equipment across teams, offering training and guidance where required.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to escalate and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner.
- Conduct routine system checks, preventative maintenance, and performance monitoring to minimise downtime and ensure infrastructure reliability.
- Maintain thorough technical documentation, including user guides, network diagrams, and records of system configurations and changes.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate III or IV in Information Technology, or a relevant tertiary qualification in ICT, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in a technical support, helpdesk, or IT operations role.
- Solid understanding of computer hardware components, operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), and common business software applications.
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral devices.
- Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and LAN/WAN connectivity.
- Familiarity with web technologies and basic website maintenance, including content management systems.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues efficiently and accurately.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and maintain composure under pressure.
- A customer-focused approach with a professional and courteous manner in all interactions.
## Preferred Qualifications
- CompTIA A+, Network+, or equivalent industry certification.
- ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL service management principles.
- Experience working in a managed service provider (MSP) or enterprise IT environment.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft 365, Azure, or Google Workspace.
- Experience with remote desktop tools and helpdesk ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Freshdesk, or Jira Service Management.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and endpoint protection solutions.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and supportive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth.
- Access ongoing training, certification support, and clear pathways for career advancement within the ICT field.
- Enjoy a stable, full-time permanent role with a competitive salary and superannuation package.
- Benefit from flexible working arrangements and a healthy work-life balance in a forward-thinking organisation.
- Work with modern technology and contribute to meaningful projects that directly support business operations and user experience.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

We are looking for a skilled and detail-focused Statistician to contribute to active research projects in the physical, life, and/or socioeconomic sciences. In this role, you will deliver expert statistical analysis and technical support, including designing data collection protocols, managing and manipulating datasets, system programming, and producing insightful reports. Your contributions will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and value of critical research outcomes.

Duties and Responsibilities

Plans and documents computer data file structures; develops, programmes, manages, and maintains complex statistical databases; performs or supervises data entry.
Selects data samples, prepares questionnaires and surveys, and conducts logic checks to uphold data quality.
Uses established statistical software and a range of standard methods to gather, analyse, and interpret data for research applications.
Formats data and prepares reports, charts, tables, and related visual materials to communicate findings.
Collaborates with fellow statisticians in designing studies, developing statistical methodology, and executing data analysis.
Assists with project planning and coordination alongside clients and internal teams.
May supervise students or data entry personnel on assigned research tasks.
Performs other job-related duties as required.
Minimum Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree; minimum of 2 years’ experience in a role directly aligned with the listed duties and responsibilities.
Additional completed degrees from accredited institutions may be considered as equivalent experience on a year-for-year basis.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required

Proficient in designing, programming, and managing complex statistical databases.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Skilled in applying statistical techniques to support scientific research and data modelling.
Competent in data formatting, reporting, and interpretation.
Understanding of programming logic and data structures.
Familiarity with statistical sampling and survey methodology.
Experienced with tools such as SAS or similar statistical software.
Competent with common software such as databases, spreadsheets, word processors, and presentation tools.
Deep knowledge of statistical research processes, methods, and best practices.
Distinguishing Characteristics

Applies statistical software to derive meaningful insights from research data.
Designs, develops, and maintains complex statistical databases.
Translates analytical results into professional reports and presentations.
Contributes to the planning and execution of study design and data strategy.
Working Conditions and Physical Effort

Minimal physical effort required.
Minimal exposure to physical risks.
Work is performed primarily in a standard office environment.
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + Super
